name: EZ Bar Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Sit tall on a bench with your feet planted on the floor and press an EZ bar straight overhead using a close overhand grip.
Brace your core, keep your upper arms close to your ears, and point your elbows forward and upward.
Lower the bar smoothly behind your head by bending your elbows until you feel a deep stretch in your triceps.
Extend your elbows smoothly to return the bar overhead.
tips: Keep your rib cage down so your lower back does not arch excessively as the bar drops.
Avoid flaring your elbows wide or moving your upper arms back and forth.
